question: No first-party hosted tier of Gotify exists: is there a vendor-run Gotify SaaS with a published price and binding limit that this corpus should track, or should the name stay as the self-hosted server?
why: The first-party site and repository publish only software under the MIT license; the pricing and cloud paths answered 404, and the host names cloud.gotify.net and gotify.cloud did not resolve through the broker. Managed Gotify is sold by third parties who run the same software on rented machines.
